title: Silhouette — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Silhouette.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Compact Excellence." Specialty tier. Silhouette is Danbys premium compact appliance brand — built-in beverage centers, wine coolers, and compact refrigerators with stainless steel construction and integrated design.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Premium compact and undercounter needs. Built-in beverage and wine storage for custom kitchens.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Silhouette:

• Premium compact line from Danby

• Built-in design for custom integration

• Stainless steel construction

• Wine and beverage center specialist

• Canadian brand with North American distribution
